result: No maintained official national notice register located in the searches and official resources checked. This is a bounded research result, not proof that no register exists.

official_resources.title: Local authority financial resilience
official_resources.finding: Dated research briefing with a historical table and separate discussion of subsection 2 notices, not a continuously maintained comprehensive register.

official_resources.title: Local Government Finance Act 1988, section 114
official_resources.finding: Record the subsection cited by each actual notice. Do not treat every notice as subsection 3.

minimum_register_fields: body identity and exact profile GSS with evidence of assignment
notice issue date, separate from publication date
page locator and selected extract without personal names
retrieval date, original file hash and retained extract hash
separate record for each supplementary notice
supersession or cessation only from an explicit later official document
search log and explicit non-exhaustive coverage
efs_rule: Exceptional Financial Support is not evidence of a section 114 notice. No cause is recorded.
